entries.title: Lamentations 3:1
segments: ¶I [am] the man [that] hath seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:2
segments: He hath led me, and brought [me into] darkness, but not [into] light.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:3
segments: Surely against me is he turned; he turneth his hand [against me] all the day.

words.text: Surely against me is he turned

entries.title: Lamentations 3:4
segments: My flesh and my skin hath he made old; he hath broken my bones.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:5
segments: He hath builded against me, and compassed [me] with gall and travail.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:6
segments: He hath set me in dark places, as [they that be] dead of old.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:7
segments: He hath hedged me about, that I cannot get out: he hath made my chain heavy.

words.text: me about, that I cannot get out

entries.title: Lamentations 3:8
segments: Also when I cry and shout, he shutteth out my prayer.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:9
segments: He hath inclosed my ways with hewn stone, he hath made my paths crooked.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:10
segments: He [was] unto me [as] a bear lying in wait, [and as] a lion in secret places.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:11
segments: He hath turned aside my ways, and pulled me in pieces: he hath made me desolate.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:12
segments: He hath bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:13
segments: He hath caused the arrows of his quiver to enter into my reins. {arrows: Heb. sons}

entries.title: Lamentations 3:14
segments: I was a derision to all my people; [and] their song all the day.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:15
segments: He hath filled me with bitterness, he hath made me drunken with wormwood. {bitterness: Heb. bitternesses}

entries.title: Lamentations 3:16
segments: He hath also broken my teeth with gravel stones, he hath covered me with ashes. {covered...: or, rolled me in the ashes}

words.text: . {covered...: or, rolled me in the ashes}

entries.title: Lamentations 3:17
segments: And thou hast removed my soul far off from peace: I forgat prosperity. {prosperity: Heb. good}

entries.title: Lamentations 3:18
segments: And I said, My strength and my hope is perished from the LORD:

entries.title: Lamentations 3:19
segments: Remembering mine affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the gall. {Remembering: or, Remember}

entries.title: Lamentations 3:20
segments: My soul hath [them] still in remembrance, and is humbled in me. {humbled: Heb. bowed}

entries.title: Lamentations 3:21
segments: ¶This I recall to my mind, therefore have I hope. {recall...: Heb. make to return to my heart}

words.text: . {recall...: Heb. make to return to my heart}

entries.title: Lamentations 3:22
segments: [It is of] the LORD'S mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:23
segments: [They are] new every morning: great [is] thy faithfulness.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:24
segments: The LORD [is] my portion, saith my soul; therefore will I hope in him.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:25
segments: The LORD [is] good unto them that wait for him, to the soul [that] seeketh him.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:26
segments: [It is] good that [a man] should both hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the LORD.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:27
segments: [It is] good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:28
segments: He sitteth alone and keepeth silence, because he hath borne [it] upon him.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:29
segments: He putteth his mouth in the dust; if so be there may be hope.

words.text: ; if so be there may be

entries.title: Lamentations 3:30
segments: He giveth [his] cheek to him that smiteth him: he is filled full with reproach.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:31
segments: For the Lord will not cast off for ever:

entries.title: Lamentations 3:32
segments: But though he cause grief, yet will he have compassion according to the multitude of his mercies.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:33
segments: For he doth not afflict willingly nor grieve the children of men. {willingly: Heb. from his heart}

entries.title: Lamentations 3:34
segments: To crush under his feet all the prisoners of the earth,

entries.title: Lamentations 3:35
segments: To turn aside the right of a man before the face of the most High, {the most High: or, a superior}

entries.title: Lamentations 3:36
segments: To subvert a man in his cause, the Lord approveth not. {approveth not: or, seeth not}

entries.title: Lamentations 3:37
segments: ¶Who [is] he [that] saith, and it cometh to pass, [when] the Lord commandeth [it] not?

words.text: , and it cometh to pass, [when] the Lord

entries.title: Lamentations 3:38
segments: Out of the mouth of the most High proceedeth not evil and good?

entries.title: Lamentations 3:39
segments: Wherefore doth a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins? {complain: or, murmur}

words.text: for the punishment of his sins

entries.title: Lamentations 3:40
segments: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to the LORD.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:41
segments: Let us lift up our heart with [our] hands unto God in the heavens.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:42
segments: ¶We have transgressed and have rebelled: thou hast not pardoned.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:43
segments: Thou hast covered with anger, and persecuted us: thou hast slain, thou hast not pitied.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:44
segments: Thou hast covered thyself with a cloud, that [our] prayer should not pass through.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:45
segments: Thou hast made us [as] the offscouring and refuse in the midst of the people.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:46
segments: All our enemies have opened their mouths against us.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:47
segments: Fear and a snare is come upon us, desolation and destruction.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:48
segments: Mine eye runneth down with rivers of water for the destruction of the daughter of my people.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:49
segments: Mine eye trickleth down, and ceaseth not, without any intermission,

entries.title: Lamentations 3:50
segments: Till the LORD look down, and behold from heaven.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:51
segments: Mine eye affecteth mine heart because of all the daughters of my city. {mine heart: Heb. my soul} {because...: or, more than all}

words.text: . {mine heart: Heb. my soul} {because...: or, more than all}

entries.title: Lamentations 3:52
segments: Mine enemies chased me sore, like a bird, without cause.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:53
segments: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and cast a stone upon me.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:54
segments: Waters flowed over mine head; [then] I said, I am cut off.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:55
segments: ¶I called upon thy name, O LORD, out of the low dungeon.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:56
segments: Thou hast heard my voice: hide not thine ear at my breathing, at my cry.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:57
segments: Thou drewest near in the day [that] I called upon thee: thou saidst, Fear not.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:58
segments: O Lord, thou hast pleaded the causes of my soul; thou hast redeemed my life.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:59
segments: O LORD, thou hast seen my wrong: judge thou my cause.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:60
segments: Thou hast seen all their vengeance [and] all their imaginations against me.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:61
segments: Thou hast heard their reproach, O LORD, [and] all their imaginations against me;

entries.title: Lamentations 3:62
segments: The lips of those that rose up against me, and their device against me all the day.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:63
segments: Behold their sitting down, and their rising up; I [am] their musick.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:64
segments: Render unto them a recompence, O LORD, according to the work of their hands.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:65
segments: Give them sorrow of heart, thy curse unto them. {sorrow...: or, obstinacy of heart}

words.text: unto them. {sorrow...: or, obstinacy of heart}

entries.title: Lamentations 3:66
segments: Persecute and destroy them in anger from under the heavens of the LORD.
